sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Nipun Singh
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Manish Kumar Nigam,J.
1.

The petitioners have prayed for quashing of the award dated 27.02.2024 passed by Additional District Magistrate (Land Acquisition), Agra in Land Acquisition Case No. 03 of 1984 insofar as it relates to Khasra No. 35 area 0.4550 hectare, Khasra No. 31 area 0.3410 hectare, Khasra No. 45 area 0.3410 hectare, Khasra No. 49/2 area 0.1260 hectare, Khasra No. 51 area 0.3790 hectare, Khasra No. 61 area 0.3540 hectare, Khasra No. 64 area 0.3540 hectare, Khasra No. 73/1 area 0.4430 hectare, Khasra No. 33/1 area 0.4430 hectare, Khasra No. 33/1(M) area 0.1700 hectare, Khasra No.
34/1(M) area 0.0830 hectare, Khasra No. 42/2(M) area 0.1200, Khasra No. 34/1(M) area 0.0880 Harcharan Singh And 7 Others vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 8 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/51359366/
1 hectare, Khasra No. 44/2(M) area 0.2860 hectare, Khasra No. 73/2 area 0.2400 hectare, Khasra No.
73/3 area 0.2020 hectare, Khasra No. 88 area 0.4050 hectare, Khasra No. 91 area 0.0380 hectare,
Khasra No. 38 area 0.1900 hectare and Khasra No. 39 area 0.2530 hectare (Total petitioners' share 0.4430 hectare of Khasra Nos. 38 and 39 only) of the Revenue Village Bhood, Tehsil & District Bulandshahr and for a writ of mandamus directingAdditional District Magistrate (Land Acquisition), Agra to prepare fresh award treating 'relevant date' with reference to which market value is to be calculated as 01.01.2014 i.e. the date of enforcement of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that in respect of same award and for same relief Writ C No. 12796 of 2024 filed by Hem Chandra against State of U.P. and U.P. Avas Evam Vikash Parishad was allowed by co-ordinate Bench of this Court by order dated 20.05.2024.
He submits that instant petition be also decided in same terms.

3. Sri Naman Agarwal, Advocate, holding brief of Sri Nipun Singh, learned counsel appearing for the U.P. Avas Evam Vikash Parishad and Sri Rajeev Gupta, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel for the State-respondents, are not in a position to dispute the aforesaid factual position.
4.
Therefore, having regard to the reasons given in judgment dated 20.05.2024, the instant petition is also allowed.

The impugned award is hereby quashed and the matter is remitted back to Additional District Magistrate (Land Acquisition), Agra-respondent no. 3 for determining compensation afresh in light of the observations made in the judgment of Hem Chandra in Writ C No. 12796 of 2024.
5. As a result, the petition stands allowed.
There is no order as to costs.

(Manish Kumar Nigam, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.)
